name: Dropbox
description: Dropbox through the external mcporter CLI: a packaged skill plus a wrapper that refreshes the OAuth access token on demand. No model tools are registered.

mcporterBin.description: mcporter executable: a path or a command name found on PATH. Default: mcporter.

mcporterConfig.description: Path to the shared mcporter config that defines the Dropbox server. The plugin only reads it.

envFile.description: Optional env file with DROPBOX_APP_KEY, DROPBOX_REFRESH_TOKEN, and related keys.

cacheDir.description: Directory for the access token cache (created with mode 0700). Default: ~/.cache/openclaw-dropbox.

serverName.description: mcporter server name for Dropbox. Default: dropbox.
